description: The image depicts a street sign situated in front of a tall, tan-colored building with numerous windows. The sign is rectangular and features a black border with a white background on the left side. The words "Auerstraße" and "Weideweg" are prominently displayed, although the latter appears to be partially obscured by the black border. The right side of the sign is gray with black text, indicating the direction of the street. The sign is securely attached to a pole on the left side
